FRONTEND bundle: /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log shows 'Web Bundled 6127ms … 1352 modules' with zero SyntaxError — the two iter11 bugs (offers.ts orphan return, event/[id].tsx:666 bundle error) are FIXED. New adult zestaw + extras flow verified end-to-end on 390×844 mobile viewport: (a) selecting cat-dzieci/urodzinki/gady HIDES zestaw picker; (b) selecting cat-dorosli/firmowe SHOWS testIDs zestaw-set1 (150 zł/os.), zestaw-set2 (180), zestaw-set3 (200) in a 3-button row; (c) tapping zestaw-set2 expands details card with all 6 menu items + 5 'Dodatki w cenie' entries; (d) core arithmetic — 40 osób × Zestaw 2 (180 zł) + 40 napoje × 20 zł = 8 000 zł EXACT — pricing-apply-btn shows '8 000,00 zł', event-revenue-input auto-fills '8000'; (e) manual override — typing '9999' into event-revenue-input flips hint to 'Cena ręczna — dotknij, aby użyć auto' and tapping pricing-apply-btn snaps back to auto (8000); (f) all 5 extras (extra-qty-napoje/taca_mies/taca_mix/salatka/ciasto) render with correct unit labels (20 zł/osoba, 200 zł/sztuka, 180 zł/sztuka, 13 zł/porcja, kwota-własna). REGRESSION verified same session: dzieci/urodzinki/gady with 25 osób → 'GADY (Pon–Czw) · baza 1450 zł + 5 × 30 zł' → 1 600 zł auto-fill; dzieci/wycieczki with 25 osób → 'Warsztaty · 25 × 90 zł / dziecko' → 2 250 zł auto-fill. TWO minor issues found (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Dodatki (napoje, ciasto, tace, sałatki)' block (ADULT_EXTRAS.map + label 'Dodatki (napoje, ciasto, tace, sałatki)') is NOT gated behind `isAdult` — it renders for kids urodzinki AND warsztaty categories too. Zestaw picker IS correctly gated (line 350 `{isAdult && …}`), but the extras UI is unconditional. Since default qty is 0 the total is unaffected, but it is confusing UX (customer editing a GADY event sees napoje/tace inputs). Suggest wrapping lines 397-425 with `{isAdult && (…)}` for consistency.

ui_bugs.component: app/event/[id].tsx (some sub-tree rendered on editor open)
ui_bugs.issue: Console warning emitted twice per editor open: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — a stray whitespace/text node lives inside a View. Likely a template literal or conditional render that returns a bare space. Non-blocking (no red screen) but should be located and wrapped in <Text>. Repro: login → cal-add-event → console shows the error before any interaction with category picker.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props (iter10/iter11 already flagged) still emit warning at boot. Replace with boxShadow for RN 0.76+ web parity. Non-blocking.
